meta.title: Remote nodes
meta.description: Runs a complete DeepSeek Harness on another machine — the brain stays there, so bash, grep, git, read_image, the terminal, MCP servers and skills all execute in that machine's own processes. Its workspaces and sessions merge straight into the local sidebar and open like local ones; because those sessions are real rows in session/list, ds-harness-remote forwards them to a phone unchanged. Add a node in Settings › Remote nodes.

sidebar.empty: No remote nodes yet. Add one in Settings › Remote nodes.
